dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello, I would like to order a big pepperoni, with extra cheese, please, at [[ADDRESS]]
{EXCUSE ME?} Excuse me? You've reached 911 ...
Yes, I know. Oh, and 2 cans of soda.
{IS IT AN EMERGENCY?} Ma'am, do you have an emergency?
Yes, I do
{BUT YOU CAN'T TALK?} ... and you can't talk about it because of someone in the room?
Yes, exactly.
{ARE YOU INJURED?} Do you also need medical attention? Is somebody hurt?
Yes, do you know how long it will be?
{I'LL SEND POLICE} I have officers about a mile away I'll send them right away
Yes... please
{STAY ON THE LINE} Can you stay on the line with me?
No. Thanks, I hope you'll get here soon!
Alright. The officers are coming!
{HANG UP} I hate these jokers ...
{IT'S A WRONG NUMBER} Excuse me, it's a wrong number.
{QUIT THE JOKES} Please quit those jokes, you are blocking the emergency line.
{ARE YOU HUNGRY?} ... and is it because you are very hungry?
{ANY WEAPONS?}Are there any weapons in the house?
{WHO IS THE OPPRESSOR?}Who is the oppressor?
{WHAT IS GOING ON?}What is going on there?

reportElement.texten: The caller was found to be in danger.
The suspect was pacified and taken to custody.
The caller was given first aid.
The caller was in fact in need of assistance and tried to reach 911 by pretending to order a pizza.
The operator has failed to help the caller.
The caller was heavily beaten and needed to be hospitalized.
